_about: S230_FRESHNESS · the legs this box watches. THIS FILE IS THE CONFIGURATION — adding, moving, widening or parking a leg is an edit here and never a change to freshness.py. Fields: name (unique, shown on the page), group (the page heading), kind (state_json | file_mtime | log_mtime | glob_newest | sqlite_max), target (the path, glob or database), max_age_h (the window in hours), note (shown under the name on the page), disabled (true parks the leg without deleting it). state_json also takes field; sqlite_max also takes table and column. {STATE_FILE} in a target expands to the collector's own state file. No numbers, ids, secrets or key paths belong in this file (F-185).
_windows: 26 h = a daily job, with two hours of slack for a late start. 50-74 h = a job that may legitimately be quiet over a closed Sunday. 200 h = weekly. 4400 h = a twice-yearly drill. A window is a first estimate for every leg whose cadence was not confirmed on the box; after one week of the page, widen the ones that cry wolf and tighten the ones that hid a real stop.
